searchText: so basically like transfer by selfdestruct Hi 👋 , I was wondering if there is a plan in place for exiting an Ethereum validator using the 0x01 withdrawal credentials? This is already implemented, or you mean to trigger the exit with the corresponding ETH1 private key? The latter will probably never be an option Thank you 😊 I was meaning to trigger the exit with ETH1 private key, i would not say never, there is some work underway to specify an “EL-initiated exits” i think the ability closes the gap on some holes in validator lifecycle mgmt
